summary: unexpected provisional credit suppression after rate-cache flush during private-postback replay
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports that provisional credits expected for a set of late postbacks from their private deployment were not applied on their provisional invoice. The invoice shows a negative-line hold (provisional credit withheld) for the time window when NovaHealth's on-prem agents replayed queued postbacks after a network outage.

Impact: Customer is seeing a ~USD 4,800 provisional hold on their provisional invoice for the billing day 2026-03-12. This prevents autopay and triggers Finance escalation. Customer requests confirmation of credit application and a timeline for correction.

Why we care: Private deployments should forward postbacks with identical tagging so credits apply; suppression of provisional credits can cause billing disputes and upset enterprise customers in compliance-sensitive verticals.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Customer's on-prem postback agent was disconnected during 2026-03-12 02:00-03:15 UTC due to a maintenance window.
2) After connectivity restored, the agent replayed ~350k postbacks and tagged them with the original timestamps.
3) The postback-reconciler accepted the messages but a global rate-cache flush occurred at 2026-03-12T03:20:10Z due to a config push.
4) Provisional credit calculation job ran at 03:25Z and did not include the reconciled entries; provisional invoice line shows suppression/hold.
5) Customer verified raw postback logs and sees 200k Accepted entries with success=200, but invoice line shows withheld provisional credit and a negative hold line.

customer_message: We replayed queued postbacks after an on-prem outage. The platform accepted the postbacks but our provisional invoice shows a withheld credit and a negative hold. Can you confirm whether the replayed events will be credited and when the provisional invoice will be corrected? Finance is blocking autopay until this is resolved.
investigation_notes:
Initial triage by Support (Mateo): verified customer postback acceptance IDs in reconciler (IDs present, http 200). Cross-checked postback timestamps vs provisional credit window; many postbacks arrived before the provisional-run cutoff but were excluded by the crediting job.
Hypothesis 1: Rate-cache flush at 03:20 caused pricing tag resolution to fallback to default tariff (no provisional buffer) which suppressed credit attribution.
Hypothesis 2: Late replayed postbacks were deduplicated by the reconciler dedupe window incorrectly and marked as 'accepted but not billable' flag set.
Observed: reconciler logs contain entries 'rate_cache_miss=true' around 03:20:10Z and crediting job recorded 503 on pricing API during the same minute.
Queries run: SELECT count(*) FROM postbacks WHERE org='novahealth' AND accepted_at BETWEEN '2026-03-12T02:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-12T03:30:00Z' => 349,872.
Billing job record: billing-run[2026-03-12-03:25] shows 'skipped_orgs: [novahealth]' with reason 'rate_lookup_unavailable'.
initial_actions_taken:
- Escalated to SRE & Billing (pager duty): alerted #support and #billing-pager.
- Pulled reconciler trace and forwarded rate_cache_miss entries to infra.
- Placed provisional hold correction ticket with billing-run team to re-run crediting pass for NovaHealth (high-priority).
- Requested customer to stop further manual replays until we confirm corrected run to avoid duplicate credits.

resolution:
Workaround: Billing team re-ran the provisional crediting job for NovaHealth with reconstructed rate table after rate-cache rebuild. Production crediting pass completed 2026-03-14 09:00Z; provisional invoice preview now includes the expected ~USD 4,800 credit and the negative hold line removed. Autopay will proceed on next cycle.
Permanent fix: Added guard to crediting job to delay run for 2 minutes after any rate-cache invalidation event and emit alert if pricing API returns 5xx during a billing run. A follow-up task was opened to make the crediting job idempotent across replays (INT-3308).
Customer confirmation: Customer confirmed receipt of corrected provisional invoice and authorized autopay unblocking.
follow_up_actions:
- INT-3308: Make provisional-crediting job idempotent and tolerant to transient pricing API errors.
- Add a reconciler metric 'rate_lookup_failures' to billing dashboard and an alert threshold.
- Update runbook: postback replay + rate-cache invalidation procedure.
- Communicate RCA and timeline to customer and Finance.
